This September in Madrid , the global telecommunications standards body, the 3GPP , will meet to decide how present-day 5G networks migrate to the emerging 6G standard, slated to begin rolling out by...

items.title: AT&T Business expands enterprise, public sector connectivity with Amazon Leo
items.summary: AT&T Business is offering Amazon Leo broadband satellite services, extending its fiber and 5G architecture with a new layer of resilient connectivity.

items.title: Verizon adds more firepower to its 6G Innovation Forum
items.summary: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Cisco, Intel, Keysight Technologies, MediaTek, Nvidia, Palo Alto Networks, Rohde & Schwarz and Viavi Solutions are joining the Verizon 6G Innovation Forum.

items.title: 6G is more than another ‘G,’ says T-Mobile CTO John Saw
items.summary: Carriers have assets that hyperscalers can’t easily replicate – including network reach and distribution, says T-Mobile CTO John Saw.

items.title: Nex-Tech Wireless selects Ericsson in modernize rural Kansas network and launch 5GSA
items.summary: Agreement includes updating 85% of Nex-Tech Wireless’ RAN footprint across Kansas, deploy a cloud-native 5G SA Core, and enable new network hosting capabilities for other mobile operators.

items.title: Ex-Bell Labs chief says 6G will need more than AI ‘magic dust’
items.summary: Former Bell Labs president Marcus Weldon says telecom will need more than AI “magic dust” to ensure 6G is a success.

items.title: Dell PowerEdge R6715 and R7715 Earn NEBS Validation for Carrier-Grade Telecom Deployments
items.summary: The NEBS-compliant PowerEdge R6715 and R7715 bring carrier-grade reliability and single-socket AMD EPYC™ efficiency to 5G and network modernization.

items.title: Nokia launches AI-edge platform for mining, emergency services and defense operations
items.summary: Nokia's Cognitive Operations (CO) is a new platform that unifies mission-critical communications, edge computing and operational AI in a single field-deployable system.

items.title: T-Mobile and SpaceX at odds? Not at this panel discussion
items.summary: Despite all the ruckus about SpaceX obliterating wireless carriers, the satellite behemoth and T-Mobile got along splendidly during a panel discussion on Thursday.

items.title: Nokia selected by Planters Broadband for fiber network in Georgia
items.summary: The deal, partially funded through the U.S. BEAD program, will bring fast, secure, and reliable connectivity to underserved communities in southeast Georgia.

items.title: How secure testing supports open RAN collaboration
items.summary: Shared testing can accelerate open RAN, but vendor data and intellectual property must remain protected.

items.title: Opinion: Ericsson’s battle to control the gateway to the autonomous economy
items.summary: There is a quite reasonable argument that network APIs are another telecom solution in search of a problem. Progress has been slow, revenues modest, and most of today's applications still treat connectivity as an invisible utility.

items.title: Huawei’s new optical engine is about more than speed
items.summary: Huawei unveiled what it describes as the industry’s first 7.2T near-packaged optics, or NPO, engine designed to move enormous volumes of data between the processors inside AI infrastructure.
